title: File naming against real library layouts: extras, specials and odd names
description: Serves "New films just appear."; "Finding something to watch is easy.". The naming rules have three tests (internal/library/naming_test.go) and every video in a movies library becomes a Movie (internal/library/scan.go), so extras, featurettes, trailers and samples beside a film are listed as films, and episodes without a season tag are skipped. Metadata files (JS-045) and the Jellyfin import (JS-060) attach to items by path, so the rules must be right first.
acceptanceCriteria: A table of real-world layouts (folders of extras, trailers, samples, specials, multi-episode files, years in names), with what each becomes and why
Extras are not listed as films; specials and season-less episodes are placed in their show
No library titles in the fixtures

A title that ends in a year-like number keeps it: synthetic table cases 'Harbor Lights 2049 (2017)', 'Harbor.Lights.2049.2017.1080p', 'Harbor Lights 2049' (no year), '2001 Night Garden (1968)', '1888 (2019)' and '2031' give the right title and year, and an existing library's item ids do not change
notes: Local trailers moved to BL-231: docs/status.md lists extras as out of scope. Extended from the Fable 5.2 blind audit, 2026-11-14.
